objective: Port the DCC planning-control lesson into the governed IDB Proof Item write path before any transaction scope expands.
goal: Make item planning behavior explicit, reviewable, and traceable so proof items are demo-stable and no planning field changes happen invisibly.

roles.name: Supply Planning Agent
roles.responsibility: Define the stable default planning policy and identify which replenishment/planning controls must be visible before write.

roles.name: SuiteScript Item Worker Agent
roles.responsibility: Apply planning controls only in the W24 pilot Proof Item writer after Customer ID and URL exist.

roles.name: Consultant UX Director Agent
roles.responsibility: Keep planning evidence compact: show policy, whether automation is disabled, and whether replenishment method is configured.

roles.name: Regression Guard Agent
roles.responsibility: Prevent hidden planning changes, transaction writes, and any expansion outside Customer + Proof Item.

runtimeParameters.defaultBehavior: disable auto planning calculations unless explicitly configured otherwise

writeBehavior.proofItemWrite: apply planning controls after account context and optional vendor context are resolved

harnessCoverage: Default stable manual planning is visible and applied.
Configured policy can preserve planning automation and set replenishment method without enabling transaction writes.
